explication: Umbraco CMS is a .NET content management system. Editors and administrators use the management API to manage content and other CMS resources; published content is served separately through the Delivery API. The graph highlights those interfaces, shared content representations, preview, search, and rendering/query capabilities. Source excerpts directly show the Delivery API query flow and management search execution; broader management features are represented from the file tree, so their internal links are omitted where implementation evidence was not sampled.
